column1: # Owner-context call-site map for PostgreSQL 17.11 (design page Rev 2, section "Closure").
# One line per source file where the server changes the current user, as recorded by
# tools/owner-context-call-sites.sh: file, then the outcome it maps to.
#   i  definer function owned outside reach      ii  foreign key (O2 entry points)
#   O3 maintenance as the table owner             caller  the caller itself, restricted
#   refused  needs CREATE on the database, already refused
#   not-reach  not reach's statement (parallel worker, transaction end, replication apply)
#   definition  defines the switch function, or names it in a comment (guc.c)
# A site with no line, or with another outcome, makes O2 apply with no condition.
